sections.content_text: Section 203 - Investigation of Source of Income If an Income-tax authority considers it necessary for any inquiry investigation or running investigation proceedings pending under this Act, may investigate any information relating to the source of income of any person concerned with such proceedings and compel to collect or supply copies of information and records relating to the source of income.
